key_idea: Look for the same 3 shapes in a row in the chain.
steps: Read the chain from top to bottom: circle, square, circle, triangle, square, triangle, circle.
For each picture, look for its 3 shapes next to each other in the chain.
Circle, square, circle is at the very top of the chain.
The chain can also be read from the bottom up. Check each picture both ways.

choice_feedback.B: The chain never has two squares next to each other.
choice_feedback.C: Reading from top to bottom, triangle, circle, square never comes in that order.
choice_feedback.D: The chain never has two circles next to each other.
choice_feedback.E: Triangle, square, circle never comes in that order, reading from the top or from the bottom.

review.note: Two answers: the chain read top-to-bottom contains circle-square-circle (A, the key), but read bottom-to-top it also contains triangle-circle-square (C). The question does not say which way to read it. Steps are method-only; fix the chain or the options before shipping.
